name: Navy V-neck short-sleeve top
description: Relaxed short-sleeve jersey top with a deep V-neck and straight body. Soft knit with casual wrinkling from wear.
rating_reason: Practical everyday staple and V draws the eye up for pear; cool saturated navy is only fair for Soft Autumn, and the cut lacks waist definition.

name: Navy bell-sleeve V-neck top
description: Deep navy knit top with a moderate V-neck and three-quarter sleeves ending in flared bell/ruffle cuffs. Straight relaxed hem.
rating_reason: Feminine sleeve detail and V-neck help balance pear proportions; navy is workable but cool for Soft Autumn and silhouette is still boxy at the waist.

name: Navy-and-white stripe long-sleeve tee
description: Classic crew-neck long-sleeve tee with thin horizontal navy stripes on a bright white ground. Soft jersey, straight relaxed fit.
rating_reason: Horizontal stripes can add upper-body width (helpful for pear) and it's wash-and-wear, but high-contrast cool navy/white clashes with Soft Autumn.

name: Olive waffle-knit colorblock top
description: Long-sleeve waffle-knit top in muted olive with darker forest-green crew neck and solid lower sleeves. Relaxed, slightly boxy hem.
rating_reason: Excellent Soft Autumn earthy greens and homestead-practical texture that hides dirt; tuck or half-tuck for pear waist definition.

name: Heather gray Mama Bear sweatshirt
description: Light heather-gray crewneck sweatshirt with a large distressed charcoal bear graphic and 'MAMA BEAR' text. Drop-shoulder relaxed fit with ribbed cuffs and hem.
rating_reason: Fun sentimental cozy piece for homestead days, but cool gray plus dark graphic reads off Soft Autumn and the boxy cut skips the waist.

name: Ivory textured knit sweater
description: Warm off-white crewneck sweater with waffle/honeycomb body, pointelle openwork at the shoulders, and ribbed neck, cuffs, and hem. Relaxed straight cut.
rating_reason: Soft cream is a Soft Autumn hero neutral with cozy texture; layer or belt/tuck for pear. Slightly precious for muddy chores but strong for cooler days.

name: Mustard crewneck sweatshirt
description: Solid muted ochre/mustard crewneck sweatshirt with ribbed cuffs and hem. Medium-weight fleece/jersey in a relaxed boxy fit.
rating_reason: Textbook Soft Autumn warm muted yellow and a washable homestead staple; pair with darker bottoms and a belt/tuck to define the pear waist.

name: Olive straight-leg pants
description: Muted moss/olive woven pants with a button waistband and relaxed straight legs. Matte twill-like fabric suited to everyday wear.
rating_reason: Soft Autumn hallmark color, dirt-hiding, and straight legs streamline pear hips—core capsule bottom.

name: Black Arizona graphic tee
description: Jet-black short-sleeve crew tee with a high-contrast white Arizona outline graphic and 'Home IS WHERE THE SAGUARO IS' text. Soft jersey, slightly fitted cut.
rating_reason: Harsh black/white contrast fights Soft Autumn; keep only for sentimental/casual use if needed, not a capsule builder.

name: Beige leopard-print tank
description: Sleeveless scoop-neck tank with wide straps and an all-over small-scale leopard/cheetah print on a muted beige base. Lightweight, loose drape.
rating_reason: Warm earthy animal print can work Soft Autumn as a layering accent; straight tank won't define pear waist—best under open layers.

name: Heather blue muscle tank
description: Muted heathered medium-blue sleeveless muscle tank with wide armholes, ribbed crew neck, and a faint dark chest graphic. Soft jersey, boxy cut.
rating_reason: Practical chore/layer piece, but cool blue and boxy no-waist shape are weak for Soft Autumn and pear.

name: Black sleeveless button blouse
description: Solid black sleeveless woven button-front top with a V-neck, pale buttons, and light gathering under the bust for a soft empire flare.
rating_reason: V and under-bust gather help pear a bit and black hides stains, but true black is harsh on Soft Autumn and wrinkles show.

name: Light heather gray tank
description: Basic light heather-gray scoop-neck tank with wide straps and a straight, non-shaped body. Thin jersey knit.
rating_reason: Useful layering basic for homestead heat, but cool gray and no waist shape make it filler rather than flattering Soft Autumn/pear.

name: Navy lace-panel sleeveless top
description: Deep muted navy/charcoal sleeveless top with vertical floral lace panels and an embroidered lace V-yoke at a high round neck. Flowy, slightly A-line drape.
rating_reason: Feminine upward detail helps pear balance, but sheer lace is less homestead-practical and dark cool tone is only fair Soft Autumn; little waist definition.

name: Black long-sleeve satin tunic
description: Solid jet-black long-sleeve tunic (or short mini-dress length) with a wide shallow V-neck and drapey fabric with a slight sheen. Straight relaxed silhouette.
rating_reason: Harsh black and shiny fabric fight Soft Autumn; straight cut skips pear waist and satin is less chore-friendly.

name: Charcoal button-front waist dress
description: Sleeveless dark charcoal/black button-front dress with deep V-neck, textured crinkle fabric, and a defined waist seam with drawstring/elastic. Slightly flared skirt.
rating_reason: Strong pear silhouette (waist + A-line) and nursing-friendly buttons, but cool near-black is only fair Soft Autumn—better if it reads soft charcoal in person.

name: Rust quilted crewneck pullover
description: Muted warm rust/terracotta crewneck pullover with an all-over quilted chevron/V texture. Thick cozy knit, relaxed boxy fit.
rating_reason: Hero Soft Autumn earthy rust, cozy and practical for NW Arkansas cool weather; belt or tuck to define pear waist.

name: Black quilted crewneck pullover
description: Solid black long-sleeve quilted pullover with a fine diamond-grid texture, ribbed crew neck and cuffs, and a slightly relaxed fit.
rating_reason: Same cozy practical construction as the rust twin, but solid black is harsh Soft Autumn—filler warmth piece only.

name: Navy floral wrap maxi dress
description: Navy jersey maxi with large cream/coral florals and olive/tan leaves, surplice wrap V-neck, short sleeves, and an elasticated defined waist with a flowing skirt.
rating_reason: Wrap + waist + A-line maxi is excellent for pear and nursing; muted floral accents soften navy for Soft Autumn and jersey is homestead-washable.

name: Unidentifiable (motion blur)
description: Extremely motion-blurred accidental shot with only diagonal streaks of tan/beige/brown; no garment can be identified.
rating_reason: Photo is unusable for wardrobe cataloguing—retake needed if this was meant to document a piece.

name: Navy peach floral wrap maxi
description: Dark navy short-sleeve maxi with surplice wrap V, elastic waist, and large painterly peach-pink, cream, and terracotta florals with sage leaves on jersey knit.
rating_reason: Same pear/nursing-friendly wrap-maxi formula with warmer Soft Autumn floral accents; strong multi-season homestead dress.

name: Olive short-sleeve midi dress
description: Muted dark olive knit midi with short sleeves, waist seam with light gathering, and a subtle A-line skirt to mid-calf. Soft jersey, practical everyday cut.
rating_reason: Excellent Soft Autumn olive, waist definition + skimming A-line for pear, washable one-and-done for busy mom days—capsule hero.

name: Black spaghetti-strap jumpsuit
description: Solid black sleeveless jumpsuit with thin spaghetti straps, V-neck, and a very relaxed oversized wide-leg silhouette. Lightweight woven fabric with soft wrinkles.
rating_reason: Harsh black plus shapeless cut works against Soft Autumn and pear waist goals; only keep if belted and layered often.

name: Olive tiered drawstring dress
description: Muted olive/sage short-sleeve tiered dress with V-neck, lettuce-edge ruffles, and an adjustable drawstring waist with ties. Soft flowy knit, midi/maxi length.
rating_reason: Soft Autumn olive, adjustable waist for postpartum/pear, feminine tiers that skim hips—practical washable hero.

name: Dusty blue smocked tiered dress
description: Muted dusty blue woven cotton-like dress with deep V, short flutter sleeves, wide smocked elastic waist, and ruffled tiered skirt. Casual feminine silhouette.
rating_reason: Excellent pear waist + tiered skirt shape and homestead-practical cotton, but dusty cool blue is only fair Soft Autumn versus warmer neutrals.

name: Blue-grey pinstripe wide pants
description: Muted dusty blue-grey trousers with thin vertical white pinstripes, thick cream elastic waistband, and a relaxed wide/straight leg in lightweight woven fabric.
rating_reason: Vertical stripes and wide legs help elongate/balance pear; elastic waist is postpartum-friendly, but cool blue-grey is middling Soft Autumn.
